# @pdanpdan/virtual-scroll Documentation for LLMs

A high-performance, flexible virtual scrolling component for Vue 3 that supports massive datasets (up to billions of pixels) through coordinate scaling.

## Core Features
- **Virtualization**: Only renders items in the viewport (plus buffer).
- **Coordinate Scaling**: Bypasses browser scroll limits (typically 10-30M pixels) by scaling "Virtual Units" (VU) to "Display Units" (DU).
- **1:1 Movement**: Ensures 1px of wheel/touch movement equals 1px of viewport movement, regardless of scale.
- **Multi-Directional**: Supports `vertical`, `horizontal`, and `both` (grid) directions.
- **Dynamic Sizing**: Supports uniform sizes, per-item sizes via function, repeating circular patterns via array (e.g. `[50, 100]`), and fully dynamic sizes measured via `ResizeObserver` (pass `null`/`0`).
- **Data-less (index-only) rows**: `items` may be a sparse array (`new Array(n)`); holes render by index and only the visible window is accessed — uniform-size lists scale to 10M+ rows with constant memory and no per-row data objects.
- **Sticky Elements**: iOS-style pushing section headers via `stickyIndices`, plus sticky `header`/`footer` slots.
- **Scroll Snapping**: `snap` prop (`'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'next'`) for automatic alignment after scrolling stops.
- **Any Scroll Container**: Virtualizes inside its own element or the browser `window`/`body` (`container` prop).
- **Virtual Scrollbars**: `virtualScrollbar` prop to force custom-drawn scrollbars (built-in or via the `scrollbar` slot / `VirtualScrollbar` component).
- **Infinite Loading**: `loading` + `loadDistance` props, `load` event and `loading` slot for pagination.
- **SSR**: `ssrRange` prop pre-renders a static in-flow block server-side for SEO.
- **Accessibility**: Automatic ARIA roles (list, grid, tree, listbox, menu), keyboard navigation.
- **Authoring guidance for recycled rows**: row components are reused as items scroll in/out — keep row state in the model, render idempotently, reserve media space (`aspect-ratio`), avoid native `loading="lazy"`, and bound/deprioritise offscreen prefetch.
- **Performance**: Fenwick Tree for $O(\log N)$ prefix sum/point updates for efficient offset calculations.

## Installation
```bash
pnpm add @pdanpdan/virtual-scroll
```

## Common Patterns & Examples

### 1. Basic Vertical List
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-vertical-fixed)
```vue
<VirtualScroll :items="items" :item-size="50">
  <template #item="{ item, index }">
    <div class="item">{{ index }}: {{ item.label }}</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 2. Grid (Table/Spreadsheet)
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-grid-fixed)
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  :items="items"
  direction="both"
  :column-count="10"
  :column-width="150"
  :item-size="40"
>
  <template #item="{ item, index }">
    <div class="cell">{{ item.value }}</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 3. Chat Interface
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-chat)
Features: dynamic heights, initial scroll to bottom, scroll restoration on history load.
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  ref="virtualScrollRef"
  :items="messages"
  restore-scroll-on-prepend
  :initial-scroll-index="messages.length - 1"
  initial-scroll-align="end"
  sticky-footer
>
  <template #item="{ item }">
    <div class="chat-bubble">{{ item.text }}</div>
  </template>
  <template #footer>
    <div class="input-area"><!-- Input field here --></div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 4. Semantic HTML Table
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-table)
Uses custom tags for correct `<table>` semantics.
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  :items="items"
  container-tag="table"
  wrapper-tag="tbody"
  item-tag="tr"
  sticky-header
>
  <template #header>
    <tr><th>ID</th><th>Name</th></tr>
  </template>
  <template #item="{ item }">
    <td>{{ item.id }}</td><td>{{ item.name }}</td>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 5. Infinite Scroll
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-infinite-scroll)
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  :items="items"
  :loading="isLoading"
  @load="fetchMoreItems"
>
  <template #item="{ item }">...</template>
  <template #loading>
    <div class="spinner">Loading more...</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 6. Sticky Sections (iOS-style)
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-sticky-sections)
Headers that "push" each other as you scroll.
```vue
<VirtualScroll :items="items" :sticky-indices="[0, 20, 40]">
  <template #item="{ item, isStickyActive }">
    <div :class="{ 'sticky-header': item.type === 'header', 'active': isStickyActive }">
      {{ item.label }}
    </div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 7. Data Browser
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-data-browser)
Grouped directory pattern: sticky section headers, instant search that rebuilds the section index, and jump-to navigation with configurable alignment over up to 250k records. `itemSize` can be a function returning different fixed sizes per item type (headers vs rows); pass `null` for ResizeObserver-measured dynamic sizes.
```vue
<VirtualScroll :items="items" :item-size="(item) => item.isHeader ? 40 : 64" :sticky-indices="stickyIndices" :gap="gap">
  <template #item="{ item, isStickyActive }">
    <div :class="{ 'sticky-header': item.type === 'header', 'active': isStickyActive }">
      {{ item.label }}
    </div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 8. Data-less Uniform List (10M+ rows)
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-vertical-fixed)
A sparse `items` placeholder plus a numeric `itemSize`: zero per-row data and constant memory at any scale. Render content from `index` only.
```vue
const items = new Array(10_000_000); // sparse placeholder, no data objects

<VirtualScroll :items="items" :item-size="40">
  <template #item="{ index }">
    <div class="item">Fixed Item {{ index }}</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```
Note: with sparse/holey `items` the `item` slot prop is `undefined` — derive content from `index`. ResizeObserver-measured dynamic sizes work the same way (sizes come from the rendered DOM).

- [Tree](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-tree) / [Masonry](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-masonry) / [Gallery](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-gallery) / [Draggable](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-draggable) / [Search](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-search) / [Diff](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-diff) / [Spreadsheet](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-spreadsheet): Advanced pattern recipes.

## Component API Highlights

### Props
- `items`: `T[]` (Required) - Data to virtualize; may be sparse (`undefined` entries) for index-only lists — holes render and the slot `item` is `undefined` for them.
- `itemSize`: `number | number[] | ((item, index) => number) | null` (Default: `40`) - Pass `null`/`0` for dynamic sizing; arrays define repeating circular patterns.
- `direction`: `'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both'`.
- `columnCount` / `columnWidth`: Grid mode columns (also accepts arrays/functions/`null` for dynamic).
- `container`: `HTMLElement | Window` - Scroll container; pass the `window` object for window/body scrolling.
- `snap`: `boolean | 'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'next'` (Default: `false`).
- `stickyIndices` / `stickyHeader` / `stickyFooter`: Sticky sections and edge slots.
- `loading` / `loadDistance`: Infinite-loading threshold and state.
- `virtualScrollbar`: `boolean` - Force virtual scrollbars even when browser limits aren't hit.
- `restoreScrollOnPrepend`: `boolean` - Prevents "jumping" when adding items to the top.
- `ssrRange`: `{ start: number, end: number, colStart?: number, colEnd?: number }` - Pre-render specific items for SEO/SSR.

### Exposed Methods (via Ref)
- `scrollToIndex(row, col?, options?)`: Options include `align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'auto'` and `behavior: 'auto' | 'smooth'`.
- `scrollToOffset(x, y, options?)`: Programmatic pixel-based scroll.
- `refresh()`: Resets all internal measurements (useful if items change size externally).

## Technical Implementation Details

### Coordinate Scaling (VU vs DU)
When the total size exceeds the browser's limit (10 million pixels, `BROWSER_MAX_SIZE`), the library calculates a `scale` factor:
`scale = Virtual_Total_Size / Browser_Max_Limit`
The browser's native scrollbar moves through `DU` (Display Units), while items are positioned and rendered in `VU` (Virtual Units).
Positioning formula: `translateY(VU_offset - (DU_scroll * scale))`

### Performance Optimization
- **Fenwick Tree**: Used to store and update item sizes. Prefix sums (finding the offset of the N-th item) and point updates (updating the size of an item) both take $O(\log N)$ time.
- **Incremental growth**: Appending items resizes the tree incrementally (no full rebuild per batch), and initialization only revisits regions that actually changed.
- **Uniform sizes need no storage**: A numeric `itemSize` / `columnWidth` resolves positions arithmetically (O(1)) — no per-row arrays are allocated, so fixed-size lists run at 10M+ rows with constant memory.
- **Index-only lists**: Sparse `items` render every index in range; only the visible window is accessed, so rows can be rendered from `index` without data objects.
- **ResizeObserver**: Automatically tracks size changes of rendered items and updates the Fenwick Tree, triggering a layout adjustment only when necessary.

## CSS Variables for Styling
Customize the default virtual scrollbar:
- `--vs-scrollbar-size`: width/height of the scrollbar.
- `--vs-scrollbar-bg`: track color.
- `--vs-scrollbar-thumb-bg`: thumb color.
- `--vs-scrollbar-radius`: border radius.

## UMD Stand-alone Examples
- [Grid Dynamic](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-grid-dynamic.html): Simultaneously virtualizes rows and columns with dynamic detection of widths from any slot structure.
- [Grid Fixed](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-grid-fixed.html): Simultaneously virtualizes rows and columns using fixed itemSize and alternating columnWidth values.
- [Horizontal Dynamic](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-horizontal-dynamic.html): Horizontal scrolling with items with different widths measured via ResizeObserver.
- [Horizontal Fixed](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-horizontal-fixed.html): Optimized for items where every item has the same width and row height is filled automatically.
- [Vertical Dynamic](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-vertical-dynamic.html): Vertical scrolling with variable item heights automatically measured using ResizeObserver.
- [Vertical Fixed](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-vertical-fixed.html): Optimized for lists where every item has the same height and items are only rendered when they enter the visible viewport.
- [Custom Scrollbar](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/feature-custom-scrollbar.html): Demonstrates the virtual scrollbar implementation that allows the scrollbar to be designed and styled by the user.
- [Infinite Scroll](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/feature-infinite-scroll.html): Demonstrates the load event and loading prop/slot for automatic pagination.
- [Sticky Sections](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/feature-sticky-sections.html): Demonstrates iOS-style sticky headers where new headers push previous ones out of view.
- [Chat Interface](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/pattern-chat.html): Chat demonstration with dynamic heights, initial scroll to bottom, and history scroll restoration.
- [Table](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/pattern-table.html): Semantic HTML table virtualization for semantically correct and accessible tabular data grids.
